info.title: Loop recommendation platform
info.description: Phase 7.1 contract only. Routes are not implemented or deployed. Owner dashboard, developer integrations, and the bounded demo share one project-scoped recommendation engine. Unknown request object fields and undeclared query parameters are rejected. Application validation enforces cross-field, authorization, file-total and event relationships beyond JSON Schema. Published scores, identities and evaluation values are illustrative contract examples, not measured results.

Issue fresh five-minute upload targets for a subset of the dataset's originally declared filenames, only while it remains unfinalized/uploading. Expected byte lengths, full-file SHA-256 digests, project and object identities cannot change. Finalized/validating/ready/rejected datasets return 409; undeclared filenames return 400. Replaying an idempotency key returns its original target URLs even after they expire; submit a new key to refresh expired targets. Never use this route to mutate an immutable dataset.

200.description: Fresh scoped upload targets; no validation job is started.

DatasetCreateRequest.description: Files total at most 50 MiB. Cutoffs must be strictly increasing and earlier than the extraction watermark. The server assigns project/dataset identities. recommendation-v1 fixes label semantics; no arbitrary objective or executable code is accepted.

UploadTarget.description: Server-selected object and exact signed headers, valid for at most five minutes. Header checksum is the base64 encoding of the declared full-file SHA-256; it is not an S3 ETag. Never persist or publish presigned URLs.

AsyncAccepted.description: A durable resource identity exists before asynchronous work begins. Poll status_url; a 202 response is not completion.

Model.description: Registration never implicitly deploys. Test metrics are not used for selection or promotion. A local seed model has job_id null and explicit local provenance.

DeploymentRequest.description: Compare-and-swap against the active generation. Exact-version validation/probe must pass before activation. Rollback targets an eligible previously served version.

KeyCreateRequest.description: Expiry must be in the future and at most 30 days after issuance. Key scopes never allow dataset uploads, training, or deployment.

KeyIssued.description: Full secret is returned once; all examples contain an unusable placeholder. Idempotent replay returns key summary with secret null, so plaintext need not be retained.

ItemBatchRequest.description: Atomic bounded batch. Conflicting duplicate item IDs fail; metadata changes create versioned snapshots rather than rewriting historical training context.

BatchAccepted.description: Durable acceptance, not feature publication. Each response count is a nonnegative integer and accepted + duplicates equals the submitted batch length. late is a subset of accepted.

EventBatchRequest.description: Atomic bounded batch. The server assigns received_at. Click/watch must reference an existing matching project/user/item impression, including an earlier impression in this batch. Identical IDs deduplicate; conflicting IDs fail.

RankedItem.description: An allocated impression_id identifies a potential exposure. It becomes an impression only after the visibility condition is met and the impression event is accepted. Baselines have score null.

RecommendationResponse.description: Pin one deployment generation and immutable feature snapshot for the complete candidate batch. Maximum 200 candidates and 20 returned items, deterministic item-ID tie-breaking. A response never itself logs an impression. Baseline responses identify the exact baseline_version and use model_version null. Learned responses use baseline_version null and a positive deployment generation.

DemoSession.description: Opaque token for a fixed demo project and server-selected pseudonymous user. Valid at most four hours and scoped to demo recommendation/event routes only. Reset creates a new session; it never deletes project data.

DemoEventInput.description: User, session, and project are derived from the demo token. Requests/impressions must belong to that session; the browser cannot report another session's exposure.

HealthResponse.description: Transport availability only; model readiness is project/version-specific.

UploadTargetsRequest.description: A subset of files declared at dataset creation. Cannot add files or change expected byte lengths/checksums.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retain for seven days per principal/project. Canonical request digest includes normalized path/body. Same key/payload replays the original resource and response status; changed payload returns 409. Secret issuance replays a masked summary with secret null.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to route, authorized project, filters and snapshot. Expires after 15 minutes. Malformed, expired, or mismatched cursor returns 400.

400.description: Malformed input, unknown field/query parameter, invalid cursor or invalid relationship.

403.description: Authenticated project member lacks the required permission or scope.

404.description: Missing resource, or a verified principal outside its project. Do not disclose which.

409.description: Conflicting idempotency payload, event identity, or resource/deployment generation.

413.description: JSON body exceeds 256 KiB, or dataset exceeds the upload limits.

429.description: Bounded request/job quota exceeded. Respect Retry-After.

503.description: Dependency/model unavailable within the request deadline.

default.description: Unexpected failure; safe message and request ID only.

RequestId.description: Safe correlation identity also returned in the body.

DashboardJWT.description: Verified Cognito token; issuer, client, token-use, expiry and project membership required. Owner/viewer role is stored server-side.

IntegrationKey.name: X-API-Key
IntegrationKey.description: High-entropy project-bound scoped developer key. Digest stored server-side; no dataset/training/deployment permission.

DemoSession.name: X-Demo-Session
DemoSession.description: Opaque session token bound server-side to one demo project/user. Never an integration key.
